title: On A Wing And A Prayer

lines.en: I was at the airport and...
One of my backpack zippers was full-on open, and I didn't notice.
lines.ja: ジッパーがうっかり全開になってたみたいで 私も気づいてなかったの

lines.en: And then, a kind, kind lady... A kind girl who was on the same elevator as me...
lines.ja: エレベーターに乗り合わせた女性が それはそれは親切な女性で…

lines.en: was like, "Oh!" "Miss, your backpack zipper is open!"
lines.ja: 「お姉さん！リュック開いてますよ！」って言ってくれて

lines.en: "Gotta be careful!" And I was like, "Oh!" "Sorry!" "Thank you so much!"
lines.ja: 「あっ！すみません！ありがとうございます！」

notes.meaning: You've got to be careful のくだけた言い方。「気をつけてね」

lines.en: "You really saved me!" "Thank you so much!" "Thank you so much! You really saved me!"
lines.ja: 「ホントに助かりました！ありがとうございます！」…っていうことがあったのね

lines.en: She was a... cute lady, yes. Mm-hmm.
lines.ja: 可愛い子だったね、うん

lines.en: 30 minutes later, I arrive and, y'know,

notes.meaning: you know の口語的な短縮形

lines.en: and then I see some of my JP senpais there too. We were flying, right?
lines.ja: そこでJPの先輩達と合流したんだけど

notes.meaning: 「先輩」という日本語がそのまま英語配信でも使われている

lines.ja: で、スバル先輩が来たら…

lines.en: Because it was actually Subaru-senpai that told me that my... My My backpack was open.
lines.ja: リュックが開いてるって教えてくれた人は スバル先輩だったんだ！

lines.en: It was each other. We were like... "Oh, you were the one with the backpack open!"
lines.ja: 先輩に「あれIRySかよ～！」って言われて

lines.en: I was like... "Oh, you were the one who was kind enough to tell me it was open!"
lines.ja: 「あの親切な人、スバル先輩だったんですか～！」って感じで…

notes.meaning: coincidence（偶然）をふざけて言う俗語
